title_en: Stories of Modern China (7/20): The White Figure in the Woods
note_en: Chinese separates searching from finding: 找 means "look for," while 找到 adds the result complement 到 to mean "find." Compare 村里人找了她三天三夜 "the villagers searched for her for three days and three nights" with 只在树林边找到了她的一只鞋子 "all they found was one of her shoes." The same 到 turns 看 "look" into 看到 "see" (终于看到一张泛黄的照片).
